settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Check the size chart linked on each product page. Outerwear is cut for a light base layer underneath; if you run between sizes, size up for cold-weather layering.

settings.question: Is Gore-Tex worth the upcharge?
settings.answer: If you are regularly out in sustained rain, yes — it is the difference between shedding water and eventually wetting through. For commute-only use, our 2.5L shells handle most conditions at a lower price.

settings.question: Do you restock sold-out sizes?
settings.answer: Core styles restock seasonally. Limited drops do not restock — sign up for restock alerts on the product page.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Contact us within 2 hours of placing the order. After that, it is already in fulfillment and cannot be modified.
